title: Roblox animation authoring
summary: A version-sensitive platform capability area for authoring and integrating rig animation through Roblox Studio workflows.

designKnowledge.verifiedScope: The official Creator Hub documents an Animation Editor workflow. Rig types, editor capabilities, import behavior, and runtime integration must be checked against current documentation before depending on a specific feature.

technicalPatterns.name: Preserve editable source
technicalPatterns.guidance: Retain the original rig and editable animation sources with export settings, tool versions, dependency information, hashes, and Roblox import records.

technicalPatterns.name: Validate in the target context
technicalPatterns.guidance: Inspect deformation and transitions in the runtime rig and camera; editor preview alone is not integration evidence.

failureModes.description: An imported runtime animation cannot be recreated from preserved source and settings.
failureModes.mitigation: Store source project, export configuration, versions, and final import details in asset provenance.

failureModes.description: An animation works in the editor but fails on the runtime rig or in a state transition.
failureModes.mitigation: Test the imported asset in its gameplay state machine and inspect representative deformations.

scenarios.action: Play a representative animation through the runtime rig and state transitions.
scenarios.expected: The runtime result matches the approved source within technical and artistic review.

scenarios.action: Re-export from preserved source and compare import details and runtime result.
scenarios.expected: The asset can be reproduced without reconstructing authoring work from scratch.

acceptanceCriteria: Current Studio workflow is verified from official documentation.
Editable source and import provenance are retained.
Runtime rig, transitions, and deformation are reviewed.

considerations: Profile active tracks and rig complexity on the certified mobile baseline.
Measure runtime behavior in the target experience rather than infer from authoring file size.

sourceRefs.title: Approved Lab source and provenance requirements

evidence.description: Official authoring documentation is linked to source retention, runtime integration, and reproducibility scenarios.

assumptions: This record does not assert support for a specific rig or experimental animation feature.
The Studio version and exact authoring environment were not recorded here.
